points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, metadata, toModel })` ... The flavour is a namespaced string, e.g. `'affine:divider'`. `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (e.g. `'content'`)... `props` gives the block's data shape.
The model is a class extending `BlockModel<Props>` (`model/block/block-model.ts`), e.g. `DividerBlockModel`.
The view is a Lit custom element extending `BlockComponent<Model>` ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal`tag-name`)` maps a flavour to a static-html tag.
Widgets attach to a block through `WidgetViewExtension`.

The store half is a class extending `StoreExtensionProvider` ... The view half is a class extending `ViewExtensionProvider`... The editor or store is given the list of these providers, and they are loaded into its extension container.
